title: Error Control Coding
description: The channel coding problem. Coding approaches and characteristics. Linear block codes. Bounds on codes. Finite fields. Cyclic, BCH and Reed-Solomon codes. Convolutional codes and the Viterbi algorithm. Error control in data storage and transmission systems.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of ECE 405, ECE 511, ELEC 405, ELEC 511.
May be offered as a joint undergraduate and graduate class.

prerequisites.text: 7.5 units of 200-level courses with any of the ECE, SENG, BME, or CSC designations
